pages.title: A obra e a situação

work.title: Kidnapped
work.note: Kidnapped é um romance de aventura do escritor escocês Robert Louis Stevenson, publicado em 1886. O elo com a língua fica claro na atividade “criar adjetivos juntando -y a um substantivo: sun → sunny, sand → sandy, rock → rocky”. A referência mostra uma costa de rochas e areia: sunny, sandy, rocky.

pages.title: A pink note · 1/3
paragraphs: It is ten in the morning in a quiet apartment in Seattle. Nico looks at a flyer about a rental apartment. The flyer says to call Ms. Park. He dials the number carefully. A friendly woman answers the phone. She is the receptionist.

“Good morning, Park and Lee. How can I help you?” says Operator. “Hello, this is Nico Silva. May I speak to Ms. Park?” says Nico. “I’m sorry, she is in a meeting. Can I take a message?” says Operator.
